phase.briefing: We have identified three Exiles who are leading this revolt against our ... authority. We would like you to go to a few locations and eliminate these targets. The last target also has a key to a safe. Bring back the documents that you find within it.

enter.say: This is the location of Lucien. Eliminate him.

phase.briefing: I have sent you the address of the second target, Ottavia.

enter.say: Be on your guard. We have reason to believe that Ottavia has a strong defense system.

phase.briefing: I have sent you the address of the final target.

enter.say: This is the last location. The target's name is Ambrose. We also need any documents that you find inside his safe. If the safe is locked; find the combination and steal the files.
